speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
text: EV Charging Operators (EVCOs) implement various incentives and disincentives to optimise usage throughout different times of the day.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will work with EVCOs to explore other measures to encourage charging during off-peak periods.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: The Senior Minister of State also pointed out that at some point Singapore will have a land constraint and looking at the constraints, we, therefore, need to look at maximising the available EV charging infrastructures and, therefore, utilisation rate.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: So, my first supplementary question is whether the Ministry is actually monitoring the utilisation at every individual EV charging stations and using this as key performance indicators in evaluating operators for future tenders and contract renewals?

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: Second, whether the Ministry will consider mandating differentiated charging fees to encourage more efficient utilisation of EV chargers across peak and off-peak periods?

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: And really, my questions are because I have received feedback from residents that, most of the time, these chargers are actually not utilised.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: But when they come home at night, when it is during peak hours, it is, therefore, over-utilised.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: So, can we smoothen out demand across the day so we can encourage better utilisation rates?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Indeed, we do face constraints, land constraints, electrical capacity constraints.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: He had also had a question as to whether or not the charger utilisation is currently being accounted for when evaluating future tenders or contract renewal.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: As to his suggestion as to whether or not we should mandate scheduled charging, there are various ways for us to look at how we can better optimise electrical charging throughout the day.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I had talked about the idle fees that some of the EVCOs actually implement.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: There are also other possibilities, such as load balancing and scheduled charging, which can help us better distribute how the electrical capacity is distributed across chargers and across buildings, and also tying that to software.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: All in all, there are other methods for us to look at how we can better make use of electricity, given our grid constraints.
